tools.name: price_history
tools.description: Price history for a deal with a 'Is this a good price?' assessment vs. the 90-day average and lowest recorded price.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of up to 4 deals by id. Marketplace offers are labeled (is_marketplace, marketplace, ships_from, delivery_days_max, shipping_cost, seller_type, store_rating); mention ships_from and delivery time to the user.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the consumer-tech categories MoneyDeals covers.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: List the brands MoneyDeals covers with the number of active deals and verified coupons, optionally filtered by category. Use it for questions like 'Which brands do you cover?'. Coverage: 160+ brands with their own MoneyDeals brand page, e.g. EcoFlow, Anker, Anker SOLIX, Jackery, BLUETTI, DJI, Insta3
